Definition: Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jeshajah is the name of seven Israelites, and the prophet Isaiah bears the same name in Hebrew. In 2 Kings 19:2, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz. The fuller story is told on the Isaiah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Isaiah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
